abstract: To explore effective treatment of large abdominal malignancies in children complicated with abdominal compartment syndrome (ACS).Six children with large abdominal malignancies complicated with ACS were admitted to our department from January 2013 to January 2016, and the changes in their breathing, heart rate, oxygen saturation, abdominal circumference, bladder pressure, and urine output, as well as the treatment measures and outcomes, were retrospectively analyzed.The 6 children included 1 child with bilateral nephroblastoma, 1 child with abdominal alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, 1 child with right ovarian malignant teratoma complicated with abdominal glioma, 1 child with abdominal malignant teratoma, 1 child with right nephroblastoma, and 1 child with left adrenal gland neuroblastoma. All patients were treated in a timely manner. The first 4 children underwent abdominal cavity decompression through surgical resection of the tumor, and the ACS was successfully cured allowing for follow-up care, whereas the last 2 patients failed to receive emergency surgery and eventually died due to the gradual aggravation of ACS.Decompression through surgical resection of the tumor is the only effective measure for treating large abdominal malignancies in children complicated with ACS.
abstract_ja: 目的：腹部コンパートメント症候群(ACS)を合併した小児の大型腹部悪性腫瘍に対する有効な治療法を検討する。方法：2013年1月から2016年1月までに当科に入院したACSを合併した大型腹部悪性腫瘍の小児6例について、呼吸、心拍数、酸素飽和度、腹囲、膀胱内圧、尿量の変化、ならびに治療措置および転帰を後方視的に解析した。結果：6例は、両側腎芽腫1例、腹部胞巣状横紋筋肉腫1例、右卵巣悪性奇形腫に腹部神経膠腫を合併した症例1例、腹部悪性奇形腫1例、右腎芽腫1例、左副腎神経芽腫1例であった。全例が適時に治療を受けた。最初の4例は腫瘍の外科的切除により腹腔減圧を受け、ACSは首尾よく治癒し、フォローアップケアが可能となった。一方、最後の2例は緊急手術を受けられず、ACSの進行により死亡した。結論：腫瘍の外科的切除による減圧は、ACSを合併した小児の大型腹部悪性腫瘍に対する唯一の有効な措置である。
